name: Guizhou RedStar Developing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guizhou RedStar Developing Co.,Ltd. research, develops, produces, and sells barium salts, strontium salts, and manganese-based products in China and internationally. It offers fine barium sulfate, high-purity manganese sulfate, electrolytic manganese dioxide, battery-grade lithium carbonate, refined thiourea, industrial sulfur, high-purity thiourea, high-purity barium chloride, high-purity barium sulfate, high-purity carbonate, and industrial barium carbonate. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Anshun, the People's Republic of China.
